text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Monday 0.70 percent higher from Friday with trade in leading shares dominating the market, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 533.74 points from 530.05 points last Friday.
"ONA group and Wafabank accounted for 18.7 million dirhams of the volume traded on the official market", a broker at ABN Amro Finance said.
ONA group the first biggest private holding closed at 680 dirhams, up five dirhams.
Dairy firm Centrale Laitiere, an offshoot of ONA group was the day's best performer with 63 dirhams to 2280 dirhams.
"There was only a small volume traded which inflated the price," the broker said.
In the banking sector, Wafabank gained eight dirhams to 685 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a blue chip stock, took nine dirhams to trade at 480 dirhams.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, fell five dirhams to close at 260 dirhams.
Credit firm Credor which was floated late December jumped 10 dirhams to 610 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 73.6 million dirhams from 37.9 million dirhams last Friday.
